title: Reliz Ltd., which operates crypto lender BlockFills, files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, reporting $50M-$100M in estimated assets and $100M-$500M in liabilities (Timmy Shen/The Block)
summary: Timmy Shen / The Block: Reliz Ltd., which operates crypto lender BlockFills, files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, reporting $50M-$100M in estimated assets and $100M-$500M in liabilities — Quick Take — Chicago-based BlockFills has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware.
